title: Seattle’s Original Sailing Cruise (Est. 1984) – 70ft Boat - BYOB
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a boat ride like nothing else in Seattle! Our 70ft custom built sailboats were created to race around the world, and now are perfectly at home on Puget Sound. Sit back and relax as our trained crew hoist the sails and turn off the engine to get great views of the Seattle city skyline and surrounding mountain ranges. Enjoy your own food and drinks while we cruise around under power of the wind.
